capabilities: Insert random questions at the cursor
Pick questions from the whole question file or per section
Configure a custom question list file
Set how many questions to take per section
Create a questions list file via a command
extras: Ships with a built-in default question list for users who don't have their own.
motivation: To get new thoughts by answering random questions from a diary prompt list.
problem: Answering the same diary prompts repeatedly can get stale; random questions help surface new thoughts.
summary: Diary plugin that picks random questions from a prepared list and inserts them at the cursor for you to answer.
